## Context / Problem
`pytest-split==0.11.0` is pinned (`pyproject.toml:274`) but `.test_durations` is git-ignored as "never committed" (`.gitignore:64-65`, task 9ad9), so no duration profile exists for splitting the suite or for the AGENTS.md 20-25 minute `make verify` budget. This story runs last in the epic so the profile covers the final suite after S1-S4. Line numbers re-checked on origin/main 6080140e7af (2026-10-26); the earlier cites were from an old commit.

## Approach
1. Remove the `.test_durations` entry and its comment (`.gitignore:64-65`).
2. Add `\.test_durations` to the `check-added-large-files` `exclude` (`.pre-commit-config.yaml:33`, now `^uv\.lock$`), making it `^(uv\.lock|\.test_durations)$`, and extend the comment above it (the 500 KB default cap would reject the file).
3. Record the profile in the SAME run as the pre-push gate. `make test` runs exactly `pytest -m "not integration and not external" -n 4 --dist worksteal -q` (`Makefile:568`), so `PYTEST_ADDOPTS="--store-durations --clean-durations" make verify` from the repo root writes `.test_durations` and gives the `make verify` result in one pass (about 60 min), instead of two full suites. pytest-split writes it on the controller's `pytest_sessionfinish` from `terminalreporter.stats` (`pytest_split/plugin.py:188-223`), keyed by node id for every test report with a non-negative duration, so the xdist workers' reports and skipped tests are included. The 17 known pandoc failures also get keys.
4. Commit `.test_durations` (sorted JSON, indent 4; size recorded on the ticket).
5. Add `### Per-test durations (.test_durations)` to `docs/local-dev-env.md` after the "Sandboxed agent hosts" section and before `### The per-test hang budget` (the "Day-to-day gates" heading is at line 495): the command above, that the file is refreshed by a deliberate re-run only, that durations are one run's wall-clock times on a loaded host (use them as relative weights, not as a budget), and `pytest --splits N --group K` usage.

Known caveat (already on this ticket): the held-out merge epic traitorous-official-sunbittern (still open) renames or merges about 170 modules, which invalidates keys; its story awake-shoddy-gyrfalcon re-runs the same command at the end. Out of scope here.

## Scope
In scope: `.gitignore`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `.test_durations` (new), `docs/local-dev-env.md`. Out of scope: any CI workflow that consumes the profile (`--splits`/`--group` is not wired into CI), `pyproject.toml`, the `Makefile`, and every test module. No test module is added: a key-count ratchet would go stale with the merge epic.

## Red proof (before the change)
`git ls-files .test_durations` prints nothing; with the file present and the `exclude` unchanged, `pre-commit run check-added-large-files --files .test_durations` FAILS (over the 500 KB cap); after step 2 it passes.

## Testing
After the run: key count `python -c "import json;print(len(json.load(open('.test_durations'))))"`; collected count `pytest --collect-only -q -m "not integration and not external" | tail -1`; nodes collected without a key and keys not collected are both counted and explained (target 0 each, since `--clean-durations` drops absent nodes); `pytest --splits 4 --group 1 --collect-only -q -m "not integration and not external"` count is about a quarter of the collected count; `pre-commit run --all-files` green; `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` green. Record the four counts, the file size and the host load on this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `.test_durations` is tracked (`git ls-files .test_durations` prints it), and the number of collected nodes with no key and of keys with no collected node are each recorded and explained (target 0), with the key count and collected count on this ticket.
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` accepts the file, and `pre-commit run check-added-large-files --files .test_durations` fails when the `exclude` change is reverted (red proof recorded).
- [ ] The `### Per-test durations (.test_durations)` section exists in `docs/local-dev-env.md` and `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` passes.
- [ ] `pytest --splits 4 --group 1 --collect-only -q -m "not integration and not external"` collects about a quarter of the suite (count recorded on this ticket).
- [ ] `make verify` shows no failure outside the known pandoc set, and the Gerrit change is `Verified +1`.
